description: This script automates the process of branching wiki pages for different versions of Google Test/Mock and updating links accordingly. It handles SVN operations and regex-based link modifications.

classes.name: WikiBrancher
classes.description: Handles the branching of wiki pages and updating links for a new version.

methods.name: DropWikiSuffix
methods.description: Removes the .wiki suffix from a filename if present.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WikiBrancher with version info, determines files to branch, and prepares regex for link updates.

methods.name: GetFilesToBranch
methods.description: Returns a list of wiki files that need to be branched, excluding already versioned and unversioned files.

methods.name: BranchFiles
methods.description: Performs SVN copy operations to branch wiki files.

methods.name: UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles
methods.description: Updates links in the branched wiki files to point to the new version.
